modes.name: Venerable
modes.description: Walk the path of the supreme, shape reality itself!

modes.name: Easy
modes.description: A favorable start with room for growth.

modes.name: Normal
modes.description: The standard cultivator's journey, balancing challenge and opportunity.

modes.name: Hard
modes.description: Forge greatness from adversity, overcoming all obstacles. Defy fate with nothing but will.

timeline.title: Timeline
timeline.description: Choose when you enter the Gu world

options.name: First Timeline
options.description: You are born on the 11th of November the same time as Fang Yuan. Some 17 years later Fang Yuan is forced to join a caravan and leaves Qing Mao mountain. Spectral Soul's heaven defying plan succeeds, however Spring Autumn Cicada is never refined instead Fang Yuan refines blood deity and becomes a demonic powerhouse.

options.name: Second Timeline (Canon)
options.description: Born same time as Fang Yuan's first life. His will travels 500 years back before awakening ceremony. Heaven's will protects him from lethal attempts.

options.name: Alternative Timeline
options.description: You ARE Fang Yuan - he never transmigrates. No Spring Autumn Cicada, but all other benefits. Skip race, location, appearance.

options.name: Late Antiquity Righteous Era
options.description: You are born many years after Spectral Soul's demon venerable's death. Shadow Sect has not been created yet and the rise of an immortal venerable is inevitable. Soul path is flourishing and the demonic path has a foothold in the mainstream, but the tides will turn with the birth of paradise earth. Cultivate to your heart's desire.

options.name: Late Antiquity Demonic Era
options.description: You are born at the end of the medieval antiquity era. Giant Sun immortal venerable is dead and the Huang Jin tribes are flourishing in northern plains. Soul path has yet to be created and a murderous demon venerable is inevitably going to rise. May you leave a footprint in history.

prep.title: Extra Preparation
prep.description: Extra preparation time before entering the Gu world

options.name: Extra Prep Time
options.description: Additional 20 years of preparation time (not available for Alternative Timeline)

race.title: Race
race.description: Choose your race and species in the Gu world

options.name: Random Race
options.description: Born as random race - variant or normal human. All up to luck.

options.name: Variant Human
options.description: You may choose to be born as any variant human. If you choose dragonman, then you start your own bloodline, with you as the ancestor instead of Duke Long. Thereby being immune to Duke Long's Dragonman Extermination killer move

options.name: Human
options.description: You may choose to be born as a human, a safe choice. Although nothing is safe in the Gu world.

options.name: Choose Sex
options.description: Choose which sex you are born as.

options.name: Random Sex
options.description: Randomly determined.

options.name: Extremely Unattractive
options.description: You will have an extremely ugly appearance, enough to ruin someone's day should their gaze land upon you.

options.name: Average Appearance
options.description: You possess an extremely average appearance.

options.name: Extremely Attractive
options.description: You have an extremely attractive appearance, and people will subconsciously treat you better because of it.

options.name: Eidetic Memory
options.description: You gain perfect eidetic memory. However, you may still forget things if you wish. This effect isn't from wisdom path Dao marks, but your natural human path Dao marks imitating wisdom path.

options.name: Innate Strength
options.description: You gain innate strength at birth. As a baby, you can break a grown man's fingers if you aren't careful. As an adult, you will have the strength of many men. This effect isn't from strength path Dao marks, but your natural human path Dao marks imitating the strength path.

options.name: Transhumanist
options.description: Human Path Dao Marks inscribe into you. You can no longer lose your sense of self or humanity and gain extreme resistance to anything that affects the mind. This allows permanent transformation into a beast, immersion in dream realms, or other experiences (or anything else really).

options.name: Flawed Savant
options.description: You gain great grandmaster attainment in any path, 2x attainment growth in it and the necessary innate talent to eventually reach supreme grandmaster in it. However, you can never grow beyond master in any other path.

options.name: Master of All
options.description: You gain master attainment in every single path, including heaven, human, dream and pill path. In addition, you can recognize every Gu worm and immortal material.

options.name: Overflowing Human Qi
options.description: You have unusually high human qi, letting you more easily ascend to Gu Immortal and guaranteeing a high-grade immortal aperture. This also gives you 2x faster attainment growth in human path and qi path.

options.name: Extra Gu Worm
options.description: Should you pass your immortal ascension, you gain an extra non-premium rank 6 immortal Gu of your choice. It may be of any path. You may take this multiple times.

options.name: Mercantile Soul
options.description: You can access Treasure Yellow Heaven at all times, possessing a divine sense even at rank 1. Goods you purchase or sell will be moved through portals in the outside world, if you have no immortal aperture. These portals open slowly and have no combat utility.

clanTier.title: Clan Tier
clanTier.description: You may freely choose which of the five regions you are born into. You may choose any tier of clan and additionally choose which status you are born into in that clan. If you choose the central continent, you will be born to a sect member instead of in a clan. You may choose to be born into any clan/sect from the story or to be born into one at random according to the chosen criteria.

options.name: Drop-in
options.description: You aren't reborn but teleport instantly over to the Gu world as you are now, without any kind of affiliation or background. You have an unopened aperture and emerge near a random human force. Everyone, including you, speaks Chinese.

options.name: Mortal Village
options.description: You and one parent are the only Gu masters.

options.name: Mid-tier Clan
options.description: Respectable clan with resources.

options.name: High-tier Clan
options.description: Powerful clan with significant influence.

options.name: Super Clan
options.description: One of the dominant forces in the region. If you pick the Child of an immortal from Superclan, you will be the child of a random immortal from the super clan/sect you picked.

options.name: Customized Child of Immortal Expert
options.description: You are the singular offspring of a pair of rank 6 Immortals. You have the liberty to design their personalities and choose the location and clan affiliation, within reasonable limits. They each possess a rank 6 immortal gu and have grandmaster attainment.

input.label: Describe your immortal parents (personalities, clan, location):

aptitude.title: Aptitude
aptitude.description: It's time to determine what dictates your mortal life, how you are treated, and your path across the mortal world. If you pick a grade, you will get a random aptitude within that aptitude range. You can roll a 2d10 or use a number generator to get a number between 0-19.

options.name: Random Aptitude
options.description: Roll the dice on your talent.

options.name: D-Grade (20%-39%)
options.description: Poor aptitude.

options.name: C-Grade (40%-59%)
options.description: Average aptitude.

options.name: B-Grade (60%-79%)
options.description: Above average.

options.name: A-Grade (80%-99%)
options.description: Exceptional aptitude.

options.name: Ten (Eleven) Extreme Physique
options.description: Choose physique. 2x attainment growth in its path.

options.name: Custom Extreme Physique
options.description: Choose two paths apart from Heaven. You are innately connected to this path starting with Dao Marks in these paths, and you also get 2x attainment growth in these paths.

luck.title: Luck
luck.description: Choose your luck modifications, which will affect your life in various ways. These are lifelong, near-immutable modifications to your luck. Only a peak rank 8 could alter these.

options.name: Nemesis Luck
options.description: During all stages of your cultivation, you will find a mortal enemy. At rank 1, another rank 1 will want to kill you for some unlikely reason. If you kill your nemesis or become a whole rank stronger than them, another will appear after a year’s delay. A nemesis will always be unusually strong for their rank.

options.name: Horizon Graveyard Luck
options.description: The luck of everyone around you falls slowly but surely, eventually dooming them. Your allies, family, and anyone who you spend time with will suffer.

options.name: Peach-blossom Luck
options.description: You will have very good luck with the opposite sex. They are more receptive to your advances and more prepared to help you. Less effective on those above your rank but still noticeable.

options.name: Platinum Luck
options.description: You are more likely to stumble upon commercial opportunities, especially auctions. Buy low, sell high.

options.name: Dog Shit Luck
options.description: Your luck is greatly improved, as if by rank 6 Dog Shit Luck.

options.name: Fortune Rivalling Heaven
options.description: In addition to enjoying immense, Ma Hong Yun tier good fortune, you naturally have a greater understanding of luck and gain attainment in luck path 2x faster.

soul.title: Soul Foundation
soul.description: Buy each lower-level soul foundation to get a specific soul foundation, starting with the ten thousand man soul. Your body also gains the necessary Dao marks/alterations to contain such a powerful soul.

options.name: Ten Thousand Man Soul
options.description: The soul foundation of a rank 5 expert. A clan leader of a super force, with all the resources that come with it, can expect to reach this soul foundation in 30 years, 20 if they use special or detrimental methods.

options.name: Hundred Thousand Man Soul
options.description: The soul foundation of a rank 6 immortal who has spent a great deal of effort strengthening their soul.

options.name: One Million Man Soul
options.description: The soul foundation of a great expert of a path that benefits from soul foundation, like refinement path, wisdom path, enslavement path, etc. Any higher, and the Dao mark interference from your soul will become too great.

options.name: Ten Million Man Soul
options.description: Only a soul path immortal would have a soul foundation this great. At this level, the interference from the soul path Dao marks on your soul would be detrimental to cultivating other paths. That is unless you have a way to get around this Dao mark interference. You naturally have a greater understanding of Soul and gain attainment in Soul path 2x faster.

venerable.title: Venerable Inheritances
venerable.description: May only choose ONE venerable inheritance

options.name: Primordial Origin
options.description: Your base lifespan is increased by 10 times, and all life-extension methods are doubled in effectiveness. Lifespan drain does not affect you.

options.name: Star Constellation
options.description: All your attainment gains are multiplied by 2. Additionally, all things that use mental energy require only half as much as they normally would.

options.name: Limitless
options.description: You now gain 3 times as many Dao marks from any source as you otherwise would. Heaven's Will doesn't take into account the existence or effect of this perk when sending you tribulations as an immortal. This perk affects any Dao marks you may gain from any perks (This stacks with dao carver).

options.name: Reckless Savage
options.description: You may transfer your true meaning to others at will or take it with their ‘consent’. ‘Consent’ may be forced, you can take attainments from captured souls, albeit more slowly than from a conscious, ensouled prisoner. You only gain attainment if they have more than you.

options.name: Genesis Lotus
options.description: You can store primeval and immortal essence in a ‘bank’ within your aperture. This makes mortal cultivation easier. Stored essence gains interest at 10% per annum, in the your aperture world’s time.

options.name: Thieving Heaven
options.description: You gain a complete venerable inheritance. The established canon is disrupted as some random individual acquires Triple Qi Retraction, Star Constellation Chessboard, or Heaven and Earth Luck. Any Immortal Gu worms associated with these inheritances are at rank 6. Anticipate unpredictable consequences. If certain elements of the inheritance are unsuitable for a mortal aperture, they will be securely stored for future use when you attain an immortal aperture. If the immortal Gu worms linked to these inheritances already exist, they will be replaced with very similar Gu worms at Rank 6. Additionally, the inheritance will guide on using that Gu worm as a substitute.

options.name: Red Lotus
options.description: You get one save slot. Upon death or conscious activation, your will goes back in time to a point you designate. The save slot then disappears.

options.name: Giant Sun
options.description: You receive all options in the 'Luck' category for free.

options.name: Spectral Soul
options.description: Your will to win is unbreakable, and you can ignore all pain, despair, and negative emotions. Additionally, all soul path effects that reinforce, grow, or pacify your soul are two times more effective.

options.name: Paradise Earth
options.description: You are born with 250 Dao Marks unrestrained heavenly Dao Marks, and your body is modified to withstand these Dao marks.

options.name: Great Dream
options.description: You may reach supreme grandmaster attainment via dream realms. 2x attainment gain in the dream path.

options.name: Heaven Refining
options.description: All your Dao marks are non-conflicting.

grabBagBundles.title: Grab Bag Perks
grabBagBundles.description: Grab bag perks are minor perks that are nice to have but not substantial enough to be full perks by themselves.

options.name: 3 Grab Bag Perks
options.description: Pick 3 of any grab bag perks

options.name: 5 Grab Bag Perks
options.description: Pick 5 of any grab bag perks

options.name: 7 Grab Bag Perks
options.description: Pick 7 of any grab bag perks

options.name: 10 Grab Bag Perks
options.description: Pick 10 of any grab bag perks

tier1.title: Tier 1 Perks
tier1.description: Basic perks to start your cultivation journey

options.name: Primeval Wealth
options.description: You acquire a rank 4 Primeval Elder Gu containing ten million primeval stones, equivalent to the wealth of a mid-sized clan. This option can be purchased multiple times.

options.name: Gu Set
options.description: You can choose 10 Gu worms of the same path from rank 1 to 5, and they will manifest in your aperture when selected. If the chosen Gu worm can be refined to a higher rank, you can instantly achieve that at no cost, with the limitation not exceeding rank 5. This perk can be acquired multiple times.

options.name: Close Combat Master
options.description: You are a battle genius and have mastered Krav Maga, Boxing, Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu, Grappling, and Muay Thai. Additionally, you possess master-level proficiency with a longsword, rapier, axe, and polearm.

options.name: Mortal Recipes
options.description: You can select any 10 mortal Gu worms and gain their rank 1 through rank 5 recipes. The recipes will use modern materials, ensuring availability. This perk is repeatable.

options.name: Inhuman Transformations
options.description: When transforming into a beastly form, you automatically gain the ability to move and control your body as if you were born in that form.

options.name: Flying Grandmaster
options.description: You attain grandmaster proficiency in flying. Even geniuses renowned for their flying skill, at most, achieve quasi-grandmaster flying attainment.

options.name: Longevity
options.description: You acquire a hundred-year lifespan Gu, which can be used to extend your lifespan or reserved for a different purpose.

options.name: Dual Dao
options.description: You can choose two paths, and these paths do not interfere with each other when used. This costs 50 CP less if you are picking the two paths from Custom Extreme Physique.

options.name: Variant Dao
options.description: If you are a variant human, you gain great grandmaster attainment in the path of your Dao. This means that dragon men gain great grandmaster in enslavement path, hairy men gain refinement path, etc. This doesn't count towards your great grandmaster attainment limit. You naturally have a greater understanding of the path associated with your race and gain attainment in that path 2x faster.

options.name: Second Aperture
options.description: You can awaken your second aperture at a time of your choosing. The second aperture functions as if created by rank 6 Second Aperture Gu, meaning it has no restriction on which rank it can rise to.

options.name: Superior Gu Set
options.description: You may pick 10 Gu worms, and they will appear in your aperture when you choose. If the Gu worm you have chosen can be refined to a higher rank, you can do so instantly at no cost when you wish, but not to a rank higher than 5. Furthermore, these 10 Gu worms do not need to be fed. You can buy this perk twice.

options.name: Immortal Recipes
options.description: You can choose 10 Gu worms, and you will obtain the rank 1 recipes, and the rank 2, etc., all the way to rank 9 for each Gu you choose. In other words, you will receive the recipe for the lowest possible rank that the Gu worm can be and up. The recipes will only contain materials that can all be found in the current era, with the higher-ranked recipes being a possible exception. They may contain very exotic or necessarily extinct, but still existing, materials.

options.name: Born Dao
options.description: You are born with 50 Dao Marks for a path of your choice. Your body is modified to withstand these Dao marks. You can only grab this once per Dao mark.

options.name: Experience
options.description: Before being born, you experience the entire life of a Random Gu master (Demontic, Righteous, lone, etc., your choice) who became immortal. The experience ends quickly after they die after reaching rank 6. If you are in the Alternative timeline, you can experience Fang Yuan’s first timeline from his point of view.

options.name: Growth
options.description: Choose any path, and you gain 2x attainment growth in it. You can only grab this once per path.

options.name: Great Love
options.description: You become a grandmaster in social manipulation, reading people, manipulating agreements, and expressing false sincerity

options.name: Wealth of Food
options.description: Upon immortal ascension a resource point is created inside your aperture for each rank 6 immortal Gu. Each resource point produces food for a corresponding immortal Gu.

options.name: Year Essence Pool
options.description: Your immortal aperture gains a year essence pool. This is an environment mimicking the river of time, that exist parallelly to your aperture. Meaning that the year essence pool doesn't take up any space in your aperture. The year essence pool also allows you to control the size of the tributary of the river of time flowing into your aperture. Meaning that you can slow the time of your aperture to anywhere between the time you rolled for, in the immortal ascension section, and that of the five regions. Wealth of Food -100 CP Upon immortal ascension a resource point is created inside your aperture for each rank 6 immortal Gu. Each resource point produces food for a corresponding immortal Gu.

tier3.title: Tier 3 Perks
tier3.description: Advanced perks for experienced Gu masters

options.name: Vital Gu
options.description: When you pass the immortal ascension, your vital Gu, along with 2 other Gu, are guaranteed to advance with you to rank 6. You can also further refine a rank 6 immortal Gu for each path you have great grandmaster attainment in.

options.name: Great Era Inheritance
options.description: You gain a rank 6 immortal inheritance that guides you from rank 1 to the peak of rank 6. The inheritance will be 500 years ahead of its time and contain Gu recipes and killer moves that are centuries ahead of its time. You may choose the inheritance to be a path of the great era like weapon path, pill path, etc.

options.name: Reinforced Physique
options.description: If you have an extreme physique you suffer none of the down sides. You will not need to fear exploding by cultivating too high in the mortal ranks. You won't need an immortal Gu corresponding to your physique to ascend. You will soar through the mortal ranks. Your ascension will be on the high end of what a normal immortal might experience, so relatively tame compared to ten extreme physiques. After this Heaven's will isn't going to hold back on tribulation.

options.name: Auto Balancer
options.description: When undergoing immortal ascension your Heaven, Earth and Human Qi will automatically be balanced for you. It's guaranteed that you will pass immortal ascension, the only thing that can stop your ascension is being killed by the tribulation itself or outside influences.

options.name: Dream Realm
options.description: A dream realm appears at a time and location of your choosing. It will contain true meaning pertaining to a path of your choice. It will be big enough for one person to achieve great grandmaster attainment and another one to achieve grandmaster attainment, or for three people to attain grandmaster attainment.

options.name: Immortal Killer Moves
options.description: You can choose 10 immortal killer moves. You learn the lowest to the highest rank possible of these killer moves. You can pick the same killer move more than once. This means that if you picked time cutting edge you can learn it again when it disappears from your memories.

options.name: Dao Physique
options.description: Don't pick anything in the aptitude section. Choose a path, you now have an extreme physique equivalent in that path. Meaning, if you chose sword path, you would have a sword path physique with all the benefits and drawbacks of a normal extreme physique.

options.name: Clone
options.description: After awakening your aperture, you can create a clone of yourself at any time, you can choose if this clone shares your other perks and attainment levels.

options.name: Servant of Heaven
options.description: You are considered an ally of Heaven's Will and enjoy its favor. Fortuitous encounters are more likely, and your tribulations are easier to handle. This effect may intensify if you fight for Heavenly Court, target fate escapees, or confront enemies of heaven. Your heaven attainment increases at twice the normal speed. However, if you betray Heaven's Will (such as by attacking fate or defying heaven), you lose this power.

options.name: Hidden Danger
options.description: At will, you can suppress your aura down to nothing or pretend to be multiple ranks lower than you are. Similarly, killer moves won't reveal any aura if you choose to conceal it.

options.name: Life and Death Aperture
options.description: Upon immortal ascension, you gain a life and death aperture. This means you will experience tribulations at half the normal strength, but you still gain the same amount of Dao marks. With this perk, you are guaranteed to get a high-grade blessed land, unless you possess an extreme physique, in which case you will gain a super-grade blessed land as usual.

options.name: Dao Carver
options.description: You now gain twice as many Dao marks from any source as you otherwise would. Heaven's Will doesn't take into account the existence or effect of this perk when sending you tribulations as an immortal. This perk affects any Dao marks you may gain from any perks. You now possess the cultivation prospects of a peak rank 8 expert or even a pseudo-venerable.

options.name: Anti-Divination
options.description: You possess a rank 9 perpetual killer move, and you can choose the path it pertains to. Only a rank 9 wisdom path immortal equipped with a rank 9 Gu will have the ability to deduce information about you. Whenever someone attempts to make deductions about you, they either fail or receive an obfuscated answer. You have the flexibility to toggle this killer move on or off. If you wish for Heaven's Will to send you tribulations, you can disable the killer move.

options.name: Rank 8 Inheritance
options.description: Rank 8 inheritance. You may choose one or two paths and gain a rank 8 inheritance of the path(s) you choose. You may not pick heaven path. If you bought 'Great Era Inheritance', this rank 8 inheritance may also be of a great era path along with the other features of 'Great era inheritance'. Regardless of if you bought 'Great era inheritance', you may pick two aspects that the inheritance specializes in. If you only choose for the inheritance to contain one path you may instead pick four: Offense, Defense, Movement, Investigation, Concealment, Healing and Aperture Management. If you choose two paths then the inheritance contain an excellent method to duel cultivate these two paths. The inheritance does not contain any Gu worms, however it contains the knowledge or how to refine, feed and use several immortal Gu. The inheritance also contains peak strength mortal killer moves that cover all aspects, and how to empower these killer moves to immortal level by using immortal materials. Of course, the inheritance also details these killer moves when used with apropiate immortal Gu. The inheritance also comes with a battlefield killer move, you may choose one specialization for the battlefield killer move : Activation speed, Killing power, Concealment, Suppression. With this inheritance you cultivation will be smooth sailing from beginning to end.

options.name: Pocket Paradise
options.description: You obtain an orb containing a blessed land, choosing the path for this land. The orb is portable and can be stored within your aperture. Upon activation outside the aperture, the orb becomes immobile. Once placed, the orb functions as a blessed land with a controlled land spirit. When not in use, you can deactivate the orb and return it to your aperture. The orb supplies the blessed land with heaven and earth Qi, allowing you to move it to any of the five regions without issues. The blessed land has an interior size of 7,000 m², and time moves 40 times faster than in the Gu world. It generates resources related to the chosen path of the blessed land. The blessed land is a paradise and remains free from tribulations. It has robust resource production, yielding 50 immortal essence stones annually, with ample room for further development.

options.name: Gu House
options.description: Choose 5 immortal Gu houses, you gain the blueprint of how to create each of these Gu houses.

options.name: Imperial Staff
options.description: You gain a staff with three teleportation opportunities. You have three opportunities to teleport to any place mentioned in the novel that exist in your era. Except you cannot go to the 9th layer of crazed demon cave.

tier5.title: Tier 5 Perks
tier5.description: Each additional Tier 5 perk after first costs +200 CP extra

options.name: Small Dream Immortal Venerable
options.description: You have master attainment in every path, providing uncanny and accurate intuitions about everything in the Gu world. You no longer have any restrictions on how many times you can buy grandmaster and great grandmaster attainment, and the price of buying attainment is halved.

options.name: Gu Maps
options.description: Gain a perfectly accurate map of the entire Gu world, stored in your head and projectable as a 3D hologram. The map includes detailed information on resource points, hidden inheritances, blessed lands, grotto-heavens, secluded domains, demographics, infrastructure, economic data, beast territory, and more. The map updates once a year.

options.name: Prodigy
options.description: In a path of your choice, you now have great grandmaster attainment and gain 4x attainment growth in it, with the talent to reach supreme grandmaster without needing outside help. This does not count towards the limit of how many great grandmaster attainments you can buy.

options.name: Legendary Expert
options.description: You have quasi-supreme grandmaster attainment in a path of your choice, making you the undisputed expert in your path alive today. However, you will still need to exert a great deal of effort to raise your attainment to supreme grandmaster.

options.name: Vital Gu Extension
options.description: Choose any Gu worm (except SAC). You acquire the capability to possess an additional Vital Gu worm. This Gu becomes your Vital Gu worm, accompanying your soul and manifesting when you first open your aperture at rank 1. It progressively advances in rank alongside you, reaching up to rank 9 automatically.

options.name: Path Founder
options.description: You may create your own path, starting off at master attainment with 2x attainment growth speed in it, along with potential for SGM. New paths are very hard to counter but won’t be quite so strong as dream path in terms of overall utility. The path should have an origin, two strengths and a weakness. For example, portal path would stem from space path (gaining somewhat from attainment in that path), be strong on speed and exploration but weak in aperture management.

premiumGu.title: Premium Gu Worms
premiumGu.description: These are special Immortal Gu that have transcended the limit of gu world, it is as if they were the apex masterpiece of a venerable. Only venerables could make them from scratch, while great grandmaster attainment in their path is needed to advance them past rank 6. They won’t need to be fed for 30 years and can fit in mortal apertures. Upon choosing these worms you learn its recipe for rank 6 and may choose when these Gu worms appear in your aperture. You cannot choose these worms from any other perk.

options.name: Break Dream
options.description: Dream Path: Destroys dream realms and counters dream path entities. Ideal for those who might face dream path moves, tribulations, or pesky enemies who hide in dream realms.

options.name: Master of Gu
options.description: Human Path: Contains the complete narrative of Reverend Insanity, including all unwritten chapters and side storys, When read it carves human path dao marks on the user, scaling with rank. It does not need immortal essence to use, only mental energy.

options.name: Path to Victory
options.description: Wisdom Path: Allows you to create optimal step-by-step plans to fulfill goals, accounting even for factors the user is unaware of. Rank 6 can only account for Rank 6 entities and below. Uses a lot of mental energy and thoughts rather than immortal essence, making it useable for mortals (albeit only for smaller, short-term plans). You can use this like the light of wisdom to brute-force immortal gu recipes but this is extremely thought-intensive.

options.name: Tribulation
options.description: Heaven Path: Causes random tribulations against a target, whether it’s an immortal, object or beast. Using it often angers heaven’s will, eventually causing it to disfavour the user’s intent. Rank 6 causes earthly tribulations with a 5% chance of heavenly tribulations. Rank 7 causes heavenly tribulations with a 5% chance of grand tribulations… Target gains dao marks if it survives the tribulation.

options.name: Chaos Flame Gu
options.description: Fire Path/Human Path (Consumable): Attaches a flame made out of Human path dao Marks to your soul. This flame can be summoned and manipulated, primarily as a weapon, instead of essence it uses mental and physical energy (but not lifespan). The strength of the flame depends on the strength of the body and soul. The flame, when not being physically manifested, can be used to nurture the body and soul and gradually strengthen them, and itself. This flame can be split off at effectively no cost and given to any willing individual, including mortals with no aptitude. When anyone uses the flame to strengthen themselves, a portion is fed back to the original user.

options.name: Universal Solvent Gu
options.description: Water Path/Refinement Path: Creates a special type of refinement water. Any materials placed in the water will be stripped of dao marks until the water is saturated. These dao marks themselves are broken down into a soup of pseudo-marks. The water created by this Gu only affects materials of the gu rank or below. This saturated water can be used when refining as a replacement for any materials of equivalent dao marks.

options.name: Self Oppression Gu
options.description: Enslavement Path: When used, anything enslaved under your control burdens its own soul with the cost of enslavement instead of you. You maintain control.

options.name: Heaven's on Central Time
options.description: Time Path (Consumable): When used in an immortal aperture, the time between tribulations is determined by central continent time instead of internal aperture time.

options.name: Mobile Formation Immortal Gu
options.description: Formation Path: When adding Mobile Formation Immortal Gu to the formation, it allows the user to move the formation freely.

options.name: Innate Strength Immortal Gu
options.description: Strength Path/Transformation Path: Innate Strength Immortal Gu allows the user to have the innate strength of the creature he transforms into.

options.name: Human Strength Gu
options.description: Human Path/Strength Path: A reusable Gu. Once a Gu Master uses the Human Strength Gu, the Gu Master gains the strength of 25 human men permanently

options.name: Partial Transformation Immortal Gu
options.description: Transformation Path/Rule Path: Partial Transformation Immortal Gu allows combining the best features of the transformation of different creatures into one creature.

options.name: Human Vessel Gu
options.description: Human Path: A reusable Gu. Once a Gu Master uses the Human Vessel Gu, the Gu Master will possess the ability to better withstand dao marks and experience reduced conflict between other dao marks.

options.name: Dang Hun Gu
options.description: Soul Path: A reusable Gu. Upon use, this gu expends soul foundation to create Guts gu at a significantly worse rate than Dang Hun Mountain. Using this gu consumes soul foundation instead of Primeval Essence.

options.name: World Map
options.description: Information Path: Reveals a huge amount of information on one's surroundings, including the location of wild immortal Gu, beasts, materials, inheritances and immortals. Rank 6 Treasure Map can only find rank 6 entities or below within a local area like a sea area or an Earth Trench. Rank 7 works on rank 7 throughout a Region. Rank 8 covers the Gu world; rank 9 covers the Gu world plus all grotto-heavens and secluded domains.

options.name: Supreme Almanac
options.description: Information Path: Contains every recipe for every non-premium mortal and immortal Gu. If anyone living or dead knows a Gu recipe, it will be inscribed on this Gu worm. Updates automatically when used. Rank 6 Almanac can only provide recipes for rank 6 Gu and below, rank 7 for rank 7, and so on.

missions.title: Missions
missions.description: These are objectives that give you extra points, but you have to complete them within 300 years of central content time or you explode and die. Spectral Soul eats your soul, and Heaven's Will foils any revival methods. You cannot escape the consequence of not completing your missions. You may pick as many missions as you want.

options.name: Traditional
options.description: Create an inheritance and a suitable inheritance ground. Describe what the trials and requirements there are to get your inheritance.

options.name: Paradise
options.description: Enter the Grotto-Heaven Blue Dragon Whale at least once.

options.name: Problem? KILL!
options.description: Destroy a super force. You don't have to kill all the members of that force, although it would be a good idea. You simply have to make it so that the super force doesn't exist anymore. This also counts if you can convince someone to exterminate for you, by trickery, commission, or other means.

options.name: Founding Ancestor
options.description: Create a super force, it may be a clan, sect, or other. The force has to nurture at least one immortal besides yourself.

options.name: Secluded Domain
options.description: Obtain a secluded domain of heaven and earth. You have to have had ownership of a secluded domain for a month for this mission to be considered successful.

options.name: Supreme Inheritance
options.description: Obtain a complete true inheritance of any venerable. Thieving Heaven's three refinement opportunities from Lang Ya isn't a true inheritance (and Thieving Heaven Venerable Inheritance perk doesn't count either).

options.name: Homewrecker
options.description: Your mission is to destroy 88 True Yang building. If 88 True Yang building is destroyed without your direct involvement, you fail.

options.name: Heavenly Court
options.description: Join Heavenly Court and loyally serve its interests. You don't have to save Fate Gu; you might even think it preferable if Red Lotus' plan comes to fruition. But you have to do what you think is best for Heavenly Court.

options.name: David and Goliath
options.description: As a mortal, defeat a cultivator 3 ranks above you, or defeat a rank 6 immortal, or as an immortal, defeat a Gu Immortal one rank above you.

options.name: Eliminate Feng Jin Huang
options.description: Your mission is to personally kill Feng Jin Huang. If Feng Jin Huang is killed without your direct involvement, you fail.

options.name: Eliminate Dao Guardian
options.description: Your mission is to personally kill a Dao Guardian. If a Dao Guardian is killed without your direct involvement, you fail.

options.name: Extra Time
options.description: You gain 200 more years of time to accomplish your missions.

options.name: Imperial Court
options.description: Enter the imperial court blessed land at least once.

options.name: Grand Theft Gu
options.description: Obtain Sovereign Immortal Fetus Gu. With the time limit, you would probably have to complete this mission by either stealing it from Spectral Soul at Yi tian mountain. Or, you could refine it again using it's user, be it Spectral Soul or Fang Yuan, as a refinement material.

options.name: Become Venerable
options.description: Break through the heavenly dao blockade and become venerable. Heaven's Will isn't interested in you becoming venerable so you have to destroy or control Fate Gu. You only have 300 years though, so you have to be very quick.

options.name: Supremacy
options.description: As a variant human, make your race dominant in the five regions. You have a 10.000 year time limit.

options.name: Pseudo Venerable
options.description: You must reach pseudo venerable battle strength in all of your aspects of combat. I.e., having pseudo venerable defensive methods isn't enough. Only available with the Late Antiquity Righteous Era or Late Antiquity Demonic Era timeline.

options.name: Dao Opponent
options.description: Defeat one of the coming venerables in battle. You must not be more than one rank above then when you defeat them, and you must not fight them while having immortal level cultivation while they are still mortal. Only available with the Late Antiquity Righteous Era or Late Antiquity Demonic Era timeline.

drawbacks.title: Drawbacks
drawbacks.description: You may take as many drawbacks as you want. However, you may not take drawbacks more than once. Drawbacks overwrite other options picked in this character creator.

options.name: No Spoilers
options.description: You cannot share the contents of Reverend Insanity with anyone. You may still act on the information but you may not try to explain it to others.

options.name: Dao Monogamous
options.description: Other paths interfere twice as much with the path of your vital Gu as they normally would. If you have dual dao, you cannot pick this drawback.

options.name: Un-undead
options.description: You cannot turn into a zombie. For good or ill, you cannot become a zombie. Lifespan is always in short supply, and you no longer have a fail-safe. You will have to pay the price to bask in the light of wisdom.

options.name: True to Your Word
options.description: You can never break an alliance agreement. Dao marks related to any contract or alliance can never be forcefully removed. You will have to be very careful with what you sign up for and always insist on a time limit.

options.name: Like a Mistress
options.description: Gu worms you own need three times as much food to be properly fed.

options.name: Halved Lifespan
options.description: Your lifespan is halved, meaning if you are human, you only have 50 years to live. Lifespan extension methods are only half as effective as they normally would be.

options.name: Dao Dunce
options.description: You cannot increase your attainment level beyond what you buy in this character creator. Unless you buy prodigy, then you can become supreme grandmaster in that chosen path.

options.name: Indivisible
options.description: You cannot create clones. Others may not create clones of you either. You may still create external wills.

options.name: Of This World
options.description: For some reason, your soul and body are one of the Gu world, only your memories are of Earth, losing your otherworldly soul and Dao marks.

options.name: Truthbound
options.description: You cannot knowingly lie. Nor can you avoid answering a question; you suffer growing and eventually debilitating pain until you answer. You may be misleading and deceptive.

options.name: Defy Reality
options.description: You cannot knowingly tell the truth. If taken with Truthbound, you may never speak, write, or use gu worms to communicate in words, though there is no pain for lying. You’re stuck with pictures, expressions, and gestures.

options.name: Clichéd Daoist
options.description: You run into a lot of xianxia literary conventions. Glance at a jade beauty? You better believe you’re courting death! Often these conventions will be subverted; you may find that the young master was only pretending to be a drooling moron, that his illogical feud with you is part of a master plan. Even so, ensure you’re ready for battle whenever you enter a restaurant.

options.name: Enemy - Fang Yuan
options.description: Fang Yuan knows about your powers and exploits from his previous life and plans to exploit you in some way. He has the support of many venerables; you will run into complications if you attempt to raze Gu Yue clan before he is born, though it is not impossible to nip him in the bud if you’re brave enough. (You can only grab this drawback if your in the Second timeline)

options.name: Enemy – Shadow Sect
options.description: Shadow Sect will try to kill you. They’ll discover you only after you draw attention to yourself or become an immortal. Initially, they’ll work indirectly by having Zombie Alliance or Defy go after you, escalating if you prove unexpectedly powerful or compromise their plans.

options.name: Enemy – Heavenly Court
options.description: After you become immortal, Heavenly Court will eventually conclude you are an enemy of heaven’s will. Their wisdom path great experts will eventually track you down and make well-calculated assassination attempts. As with Shadow Sect, HC has many other priorities and will only react quickly and aggressively if you draw a lot of attention to yourself.

options.name: Principled Protagonist
options.description: You can’t take demonic actions, from the point of view of both Gu World and Earth. For example, while the righteous path might try to enslave or exterminate variant humans, you may not even violate the Geneva Conventions. Sneak-attacking and so on are out too.

options.name: Lone Cultivator
options.description: You may never ally with anyone longer than 24 hours, either in combat or in cultivation. You can still live with your parents or find lovers as long as you don’t give or receive aid in the above.

options.name: Filial Promise
options.description: You may not attack a human or variant human with the intent to kill.

options.name: Benefits Addict
options.description: You become excessively greedy. While this increases your will to fight and work hard, it also makes you more of a risk-taker and somewhat more easily manipulated (bribery). You are unwilling to sacrifice your wealth.

options.name: Local Dao
options.description: You are no longer an otherworldly demon. You will not have otherworldly dao marks and others cannot figure out your origin no matter what method they use. Not even soul searching you will let them find out you aren't from the Gu world.

options.name: Weakness
options.description: Choose one path, you are now twice as vulnerable to that path as you normally would be. You can pick this multiple times.

options.name: Inhospitable Environment
options.description: Choose a region, you cannot enter that region. This goes away when the regional walls disappears.

options.name: Clear Conscience
options.description: You cannot knowingly lie, and you are compelled to answer any question asked truthfully.

options.name: Forget Me Now
options.description: You lose all memory of reading Reverend Insanity upon rebirth. You still remember the options you took in this CYOA, and your previous life. If you picked reading materials in your grab bag it is removed and you can pick another.

grabBagItems.name: Reading Materials
grabBagItems.description: You have a popup window where you can read Reverend Insanity and the Reverend Insanity wiki; only you can read it.

grabBagItems.name: Gu Professor
grabBagItems.description: You always know if an immortal Gu exists or not.

grabBagItems.name: Polyglot
grabBagItems.description: You can speak and read the language of every region.

grabBagItems.name: Thousand Man Soul
grabBagItems.description: You are born with a 1,000 man soul. With this soul foundation, you could control more than 100,000 beasts with enslavement path methods. As a Gu master, your soul is also strong enough to beat all but rank 5 experts in a battle between souls.

grabBagItems.name: Otherworldly Dao
grabBagItems.description: Choose what otherworldly Dao mark your soul comes with.

grabBagItems.name: Settra
grabBagItems.description: Slavery Gu, of any rank, does not work on you.

grabBagItems.name: Change Will
grabBagItems.description: You can change an ideal of yourself to better fit the Gu world.

grabBagItems.name: Memories
grabBagItems.description: Before being born, you gain the memories of a mortal whole life that wasn’t involved with Gu Master's life.

grabBagItems.name: Instant Success
grabBagItems.description: Gu worms that carve Dao marks on the user, like Black Boar Gu, Iron Bone Gu, etc., will have their full effects shown immediately and painlessly upon use, and they won't need primeval essence to activate.

grabBagItems.name: Mutated Soul
grabBagItems.description: You may choose for your soul to be a mutated soul. For example, if you choose to have a wolfman soul, your soul would have wolf characteristics and would be many times stronger when controlling wolves.

grabBagItems.name: Flying Master
grabBagItems.description: You now have master-level attainment in flying.

grabBagItems.name: Secret Manuals
grabBagItems.description: As shown by Red Lotus Demon Venerable's past, Gu cultivation isn't the only cultivation system to exist in this world. There are secret manuals that mortals who haven't or couldn't awaken their aperture can use to produce supernatural effects. However, such cultivation is very minor compared to Gu Cultivation. You gain 3 secret manuals of your choice.
